result.summary: Found 1 critical issue: the bottom navigation is visually broken and blocked by a thick black bar obscuring the central icons.

issues.description: Bottom navigation bar is obscured by a thick black horizontal bar covering the middle icons (search and saved/bookmark), leaving them unreadable and untappable
issues.suggestion: Remove or fix the overlaying black bar, ensure system gesture indicator does not overlap the navigation, and restore full visibility and tap targets for all bottom navigation icons
